posts.text: Excited to be joining Terminal this year! Grateful for the opportunity and looking forward to building and learning alongside such an incredible team 🤝

With just a few hours left before the year ends, I wanted to take a moment to reflect on one of the most meaningful experiences of my year. Hackathons were what first sparked my interest in entrepreneurship, so being able to give back to the student community by organising NUS Entrepreneurship Society's CatalystX as Deputy Head felt very full-circle.
